verdict.rationale: Channel3 ships a CLI, an SDK and an MCP server, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The optional user identifier for attributing clicks and sales is a different feature and does not count as an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
